svg.text: SCALE 20:1 · SM · INDEX LABELS ARE ANNOTATIONS
GRID IS A BLOCK. PARENT MAY STRETCH ITS TRACKS.
W0 IS THE COMPACT ENVELOPE, NOT A FIXED ROOT WIDTH.
N = G × G I ELEMENTS IN ROW-MAJOR ORDER.
GRID SIDE G IS 4 OR 5 (GRID PROP).
SIZE CHANGES CELL AND GAP TOGETHER.
SHAPE: SQUARE CELLS OR ROUND DOTS.
TEN PATTERNS. DELAYS ARE RULES OF ROW,
COLUMN AND G, SO EACH FITS BOTH GRIDS.
HASH: RANDOM PER-DOT PHASE AND CYCLE,
SET ON THE CLIENT AFTER MOUNT.
LABEL ADDS ROLE STATUS AND A NAME.
LAYER LIFT BELOW IS EXPLANATORY ONLY.
SHAPE DOES NOT CHANGE Z1, S1 OR W0.
PROPORTIONAL · NO PHYSICAL DEPTH OR Z DIMENSION
TRACKS → CELL FILL → CSS OPACITY PHASE.
SCHEMATIC · OTHER PATTERNS USE THEIR OWN KEYFRAMES
WAKE ORDER · DARKEST FIRST · HATCHED = NOT YET LIT · LIT SHARE FOLLOWS PULSE WIDTH
TURN = CLOCKWISE ANGLE FROM UP AROUND THE GRID CENTRE ÷ 360°. BACKPROP ⇄: A SECOND, ADDED PASS RETURNS FROM THE LAST COLUMN. HASH: ONE RANDOM SAMPLE; ITS ORDER NEVER REPEATS.
